$description: Typography roles (web regular and compact; mobile uses compact).

com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

type.$description: Typography roles. Each role has a 'web' composite (regular layout) and a 'compact' composite (at and below its compact breakpoint; iOS and Android use the compact values 1px = 1pt = 1dp/sp). Fluid roles also carry the clamp() definition used on the web.
